rca of the issue: Customer reported v44.00.08 didn't fix 'gws-simple-push timer kurulmamış' because widget checked exim_logtail_pos.last_push_at (populated ONLY by gws-exim-push actually pushing exim logs) — but gws-simple-push only calls /api/plugin/heartbeat which was ONLY writing licenses.last_heartbeat_at, never touching exim_logtail_pos. Fix (server.py lines 7092-7108): heartbeat handler now upserts settings:{_key:exim_logtail_pos:{key}} with last_push_at=now and last_push_source='heartbeat'. Result: widget goes green within 5 min of gws-simple-push.timer firing even before real exim push data arrives. Verified via direct DB read + /outbound/stats API.
